book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: Bol gɛɛŋ Masɛdonia bɛ Glee
Ŋgɛ wù gɛ̀ bee Ɛfɛsu ka, Bol tɛɛŋ ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ, wu teefe bo wu mo wu yɛsɛ bo le, wu tu wu gɛɛne masɛdonia.
Wu gɛɛŋ, wu jiɛnyɛ bimbe bi yo le, wu kaŋse muntele mu bamii ba mbɛmɛ chuule wu mo wu daŋsɛ wu gɛɛŋ Glee,

wu che yo kii yi tɛde. Wu gɛ̀ ja fi nyu lɛ wu lé wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu lêe a ŋguh wu a joo le wu gɛɛŋ Silia, wu mo wu yu lɛ Bajuu weede wu a je. Wu mo wu yɛŋ lɛ joŋe lɛ wu kâasɛ wu tû jiŋ je yi Masɛdonia le.
Wu gɛ̀ jiɛnyi bɛ ba Sobata mwa Bilu wù Bɛlia, mo Alistaku bɛ Sɛkundu ba Tɛsalonika, mo Gayu wu Dɛbi, mo Timoti, mo Tichiku bɛ Tofimu ba gɛ̀ bee bamii ba Ɛsia.
Bamii banɛ mo bo gɛɛŋ fwe bo tu bo chiɛɛne besa ba Bol Towa.
Ŋka wu Blɛd wù ba baaŋ gɛɛ gɛ Kinshilɛ yo gɛ fe, bee lee a ŋguh le Filibi, bee jo aju atɛŋ bee taa bo le Towa, besa bo che yo aju bvusooshwi.
Bol ka wu la jigɛ a kintaashɛ ki Towa le
Lɛ to nyu juu chi fwe yi kimaa le, bee tasɛ yi kintaashɛ le fɛnfu ki bee bwɛɛyɛ blɛd. No Bol gɛ̀ bee ki wu bû wu ja sege bvu yuu, wu mo wu kɛ wu jɛme bo le, wu jɛme shwaa gɛɛŋ bu antaŋ antɛnɛɛ.
Besa bo gɛ̀ bee nyu a kibuu ki yeh yi awe le, bin'yesɛ baaŋ yu wesee.

Chumu wumu wù jee che gɛ̀ bee Yutiku shii yi nto wu yeh yɛɛ le. Wu ja wu kɛ wu tu wu lefe, no Bol gɛ̀ jɛme wu gɛɛne gɛh lo. Lefe doo chi goge wa lo wu, wu mo wu ja fo wu gwe achiŋ, fo gɛ̀ bee yeh yi fɛwe yi shɛde kɛge fɛkuu. Ba gɛɛŋ ba jo wu a wu kwe wa.
Bol shii wu gɛɛŋ wu ŋgvuumɛ a wu we, wu kfugɛ wu, wu jɛmɛ bamii le lɛ, “Kiyo ke baaŋ yu, keefɛ bɛŋ bûge gɛ.”
Bol ja wu kaasɛ wu bɛɛŋ a kibuu ki awe kɛɛ le, wu bwɛɛde blɛd wu ji, fɛ wu ka wu kɛ wu tu wu jɛme, wu tu wu jɛme bvuchvuu bu bvu yuu wu mo wu ja.
Bamii gɛ̀ jo chumu wɛɛ bo kwɛɛ bɛ wu fɛ wu yeh le wù nyu wu tu wa wu wuŋe, muntele jɛde bo.
Bol nya ntefɛ bachiji kintaashɛ ki Ɛfɛsu le
Bee gɛ̀ lee a ŋguh wu a joo le, bee gɛɛŋ Aso, no Bol gɛ̀ seesɛ wa lɛ le yo a bee lé be jô wu yo. Wu gɛ̀ jɛme noo, nje wu gɛ̀ goone ki wu jîɛnyɛ bɛ bikaa.
Wu taa bee le Aso, bee mo be jo wu a ŋguh le, besa bo gɛɛŋ bee bu Mitiliŋ.
Bee ja fo a ŋguh le, bvu bu bvu yuu, bee fɛsɛ mbebe Kio le, bee fe, bvu ka bvu yuu, bee fɛsɛ Samo, bee mo bee fe, bvu ka bvu yuu, bee lee Miletu.
Bee gɛ̀ jiɛnyi noo, bee wɛɛne lo Ɛfɛsu nje gɛ Bol gɛ goone ki wu fêesɛ kife Ɛsia gɛ. Wu gɛh gɛɛne chige chige laa taŋlo wù nyû Yɛlusalɛm juu chi Ŋka wu Bɛntɛko le lɛ.
Lɛ bee lee Miletu, Bol chiiŋsɛ ntuŋ fɛ bachiji kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ le Ɛfɛsu lɛ bo tô bo yɛ̂ŋ wu le.
Bo gɛ̀ to, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ kee no kinche kaŋ gɛ̀ bee besabɛŋ kɛge yi juu chi fwe chì ŋgɛ̀ ntomɛ kikaa yi nshɛŋ yi Ɛsia yinɛ le.
Ŋgɛ̀ mbee nshiishɛ kikwɛɛ kaŋ, ntu nlɛne fɛ Nyo le bɛ joo ajii le. Ŋka n'yɛŋ baŋgɛ jé le wesee no Bajuu gɛ̀ boone bikaa a mɛ jiŋ.
Bɛŋ ka kee no ŋgɛ̀ n'yɛyi bɛŋ fɛ waaŋ, ŋka njiɛnyi n'yɛyi yéh le. Ŋgɛ mbaaŋ nyilɛ gɛ fiɛɛ fimi fì taŋlo fi fii bɛŋ gɛ.
Ŋgɛ̀ nfeeji gɛh nyu fiɛɛ fimimia Bajuu le mo bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ, nduu lɛ bo kûsɛ muntele muboo, bo tû bɛ Nyo, bo lêe fitele yi Tada wese bɛsabɛŋ wu Jiso Kletu le.
Mɛɛse, bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, ŋgɛɛne Yɛlusalɛm nyu no Kiyo ki Yuude jɛmɛ mɛne, ŋkee gɛ laa gɛɛne kooshɛ la bɛ mɛ yo la.
Fiɛɛ fì ŋkee le gɛh lɛ manjuu manchii ma nfede mo le, le Kiyo ki Yuude sɛŋe mɛne lɛ ncha bɛ ŋgɛ chiɛɛne mɛ fwe.
Geenɛ, gɛ n'yɛde kinche kaŋ lɛ le fiɛɛ gɛ, fede lɛ mɛ mɛ̂sɛ lɛme chì Tada Jiso le wu nya mɛne chì le lɛ nfêeji saaka wù joŋe wù kune no Nyo le wu ndunyɛ fitele fì joŋe fɛ bamii be le.
Yi mɛɛse le, bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, ŋkee lɛ gɛ muh mu bɛŋ le wù besabɛŋ bɛ bo chi bee, nfeeji kune bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo wu baaŋ wu ka wu yɛ̂ŋ bvushi bwaŋ le gɛ.
Mɛ mo njɛme bɛŋ le chuule abɛŋ lɛ nɛ muh mu bɛŋ le lɛse lo mɛɛse, tu gɛ ŋkɛme kibo fo gɛ,
nje nchi mbaaŋ nyilɛ gɛ ki nsɛɛŋ bɛŋ fiɛɛ fichii fì Nyo goone gɛ.

Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ shɛɛ, bɛŋ bîji fɛ bikwɛɛ biɛna le mo fɛ ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ le bo le njɛ shóŋ, yi Kiyo ki Yuude le ki gɛɛ bɛŋ a bo we. Bɛŋ nyûme banchiɛnɛ shóŋ ba kintaashɛ ki bamii ba Nyo kì wu gɛ̀ gu bɛ kilɛmɛ ki Mwa ye.
Ŋkee lo lɛ ŋge ndoo mbaa kikaa, bakfuula tô bo lêe ŋgoo yɛnɛ le, bo gɛ ya bo châge lo muh wù bo koo gɛ.
Bamii bamu, le bo bu mo a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ bo lɛ̂ɛde bɛ ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ, bo chiide bo tuu a ŋgoo yiboo le.
Noo, bɛŋ yɛ̂ne, bɛŋ kwâji lɛ yi biluŋ le bitɛde nle n'yɛyɛ wa bɛŋ bachii antaŋ bɛ fɛnshɛ bɛ joo ajii le.

Mɛ mo nyâa bɛŋ mɛɛse chiaaŋ yi Nyo le mo yi jɛ ye yì le kune nfii wù Nyo fɛ bamii le. Jɛ yinɛ le yì taŋlo yi gê bɛŋ kûu, fi le lɛ bɛŋ tô bɛŋ kɛ̂mɛ kijuu fɛ kijusɛ ki Nyo le wu gɛɛ bamii ba wu le wu ge lɛ bo nyûme be.
Ŋgɛ̀ mbaaŋ a booŋ gɛ ajii yi bige bi muh le kɛnɛ yi njú yi muh le gɛ.
Bɛŋ kee chuule lɛ le chiaaŋ yaŋ chinɛ yì gɛ̀ lɛne fiɛɛ fichii fì besa ŋgoo yaŋ gɛ̀ goone.
Yi mwɛɛ munchii le, ŋgɛ̀ nduunyi bɛŋ le lɛ muh kɛme ki wu lɛ̂ne chuule ki wu fîih bamii baŋgɛ, kwaji no Tada Jiso gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: ‘Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le ki muh wù nyaa lo, fede muh wù fii lo le.’”

content: No Bol mɛse jɛmɛ noo, bɛ bo mo bo tuŋ anyuu fɛkuu bachii, bo buunɛ.
Bo ja bo kesɛ bɛ kwe bo tu bo beede, bo kfugɛ Bol bo shiiŋe wu, lɛ ba shɛɛ wa.
Fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ ge fɛ bo tu bo beede baaŋ nɛ, le jɛ yì Bol gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ gɛ bo baaŋ bo ka bo yɛŋ bvushi bweŋ le gɛ. Bo mo bo chiiŋsɛ wu bo gɛɛŋ bo bu fɛ wù gɛ̀ bee ki wu lêe ŋguh wu a joo fo.
